about_the_game:
🐾 About This Game

Furry College is a sparkling, satirical adult visual novel that follows the chaotic rise of a young cat girl chasing the dream of fame and glamour.
Her goal? Become the next big thing on Instacat, the hottest social network in the feline world!

Between embarrassing misunderstandings, spicy rumors, and unforgettable encounters, our ambitious (and occasionally clumsy) heroine will navigate the ups and downs of college life — one selfie at a time.

Will she become a viral sensation… or just another meme?

✨ Features

  • Make your choices, shape her destiny.
    Every decision affects the protagonist’s popularity, reputation, and relationships — from harmless flirtations to full-blown scandals.

  • Meet a colorful cast of characters.
    From overly confident cheerleaders to eccentric professors and jealous rivals — each encounter hides opportunities (and potential disasters).

  • Explore the campus like never before.
    Discover classrooms, dorms, and secret corners of Pinecreek College as you unlock alternative scenes and exclusive storylines.

  • Comedy, charm, and chaos.
    A brilliant mix of humor, adventure, and cheeky moments that poke fun at influencer culture and college clichés — with a feline twist.

  • Multiple routes and endings.
    Build your own version of the story — from innocent to wildly provocative — depending on how daring you want to be.

😸 Why You’ll Love It

If you enjoy lighthearted adult stories with witty dialogue, sassy characters, and a dash of social satire, Furry College will make you purr with laughter.
It’s Legally Blonde meets Animal House — with fur, flair, and fabulous filters.

🐱 Meet the Cast

At Pinecreek College, no day is ever ordinary — and no cat keeps their fur clean for long!
Here are some of the unforgettable personalities that will cross your path:

🐾 Mittens – The Dreamer
(You can customize her name)
Our ambitious but hopelessly clumsy protagonist.
Armed with charm, curiosity, and questionable judgment, she’s determined to become an Instacat star — even if that means surviving embarrassing auditions, viral fails, and chaotic roommates.

🎀 Debbie – The Best Friend... or Frenemy?
Sweet, loyal, and a little too curious about Mittens’s “career choices.”
Debbie tries to help, but her advice often leads to the exact opposite of what she intends — with hilarious and sometimes revealing consequences.

💅 Alison & Lara – The Influencer Queens
The reigning divas of Instacat, always posing, posting, and plotting.
They’re glamorous, sarcastic, and terrifyingly good at destroying reputations with a single story. Getting on their good side might be the biggest challenge on campus.

🦊 Juno – The Schemer
Smart, sharp-tongued, and impossible to read.
She knows everyone’s secrets — including Mittens’s — and loves to push others out of their comfort zone. Whether she’s a rival or a twisted ally depends entirely on you.

👩‍🍳 Roxie – The Wildcard
A chaotic coworker from the campus café with an unpredictable temper and a strange fascination for Mittens’s misfortunes.
Half troublemaker, half romantic interest — all entertainment.

🐯 Agatha & 🐶 Harrison – The Landlords from Another Era
Agatha runs the household with an iron paw and an obsession for discipline, while her meek husband Harrison just tries to stay out of the way.
Living with them is part sitcom, part social experiment.

Together, they form a gallery of absurd, funny, and surprisingly relatable characters — each capable of making Mittens’s life a little more complicated... or unforgettable.
